Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: 10+2 with diploma/certificate course in Pre-school Education/Early childhood care education/Nursery School Training (NTT) OR Pre School Education certificate course/creche Management/Child care, graduate in Home Science & PG in Child development/PG English/PG Education/PG in Social Science subject related to Child Care Management. Basic Computer knowledge. Minimum 06 months experience desirable in Any Play School/Day Care Centre/Creche/Child Care Work.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Allahabad University Part-time Early Childhood Facilitator (Female) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.
